correctness.rationale: Define v=-log(1-u)>0. Then J_beta(u)=v^(beta-1)(beta+1-v)/Gamma(beta+1), asymptotic -v^beta/Gamma(beta+1) -> -infinity as u->1^- for every beta>0. The paper explicitly defines 0<u<1, but Eq(7) evaluates i/n through i=n, leaving J_beta(1) undefined; if extended by left limit, the X_(n)>0 term is -infinity almost surely under exponential sampling. Eq(9) averages J_beta(i/n) through n in each coefficient b_(r,n), so no finite exact-null coefficients exist as printed. Derivative dJ/dv = v^(beta-2)(beta^2-1-beta*v)/Gamma(beta+1), so beta>1 is not monotonic, contradicting all-beta monotonicity in Remark 3.1. This is exact algebra, not a numerical inference. Crucially Remark 3.1 also mentions interior u_r=r/(n+1), but this is NOT the i/n endpoint rule printed in Eqs(7)/(9); the audit concerns literal formulas only.
